events.title: Steam Next Fest is Live! Play the Dacan Express Demo & Watch the Broadcast 🚚📦
events.summary: Steam Next Fest has officially launched!Step into the shoes of a logistics manager and build your delivery empire from the ground up. The updated, fully polished demo of Dacan Express is now available to download and play for free!What awaits you in the demo:Squad & District Management: Assign dispatchers and couriers across expanding urban zones.Depot & Fleet Logistics: Purchase used delivery vans and heavy trucks, manage vehicle wear, and negotiate night sorting shifts.Dynamic Urban Challenges

events.title: Dacan Express – Steam Next Fest Livestream & Gameplay Demo
events.summary: Welcome to the Dacan Express livestream during Steam Next Fest!In this broadcast, you can watch gameplay footage showcasing:• Fleet management and route dispatching• Courier hiring and depot operations• Contract negotiations and economic expansion🎮 The playable demo is available now! Try it directly on our store page and make sure to add Dacan Express to your Wishlist.

events.title: Demo Update: Streamlined Finances & All Depots Unlocked!
events.summary: Hey everyone!A new update for the demo is now live, bringing several key improvements:Clearer Financial Audit: Redesigned accounting dashboard with a fully readable, stable 7-day profit history.All Depots Unlocked: To make the gameplay deeper and more diverse, all city branches and depots are now accessible in the demo.Expanded In-Game Manual: Comprehensive details covering squad synergy, e-shop contracts, city traffic penalties, and fleet maintenance.I hope you enjoy this improved demo version!

events.title: Demo Update 1.0.1: Polished UI, Depot Overtime & Enhanced Tutorial!
